source_caption:
To visually cement Peter Parker’s transition from a billionaire-funded Avenger back to his independent, street-level comic book roots, the final swing sequence features a brand-new, hand-sewn suit that was entirely computer-generated. Because Marvel Studios’ Head of Visual Development Ryan Meinerding was continually refining the brightly colored red-and-blue design—specifically tweaking the front and back spider emblems to subtly incorporate stylistic elements from both Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield’s costumes as a hidden homage to his multiversal mentors—the production ran out of time to manufacture a physical, practical suit before filming wrapped. Consequently, the visual effects team had to animate the entire sweeping final shot through a snowy Rockefeller Center based strictly on digital concept art, meticulously rendering the creasing and fluttering of the fabric to sell the illusion of a cheap, low-tech garment sewn on a vintage sewing machine.

Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021), directed by Jon Watts, starring Tom Holland, Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon. After his secret identity is exposed to the world, a desperate Peter Parker seeks magical help from Doctor Strange, inadvertently fracturing the multiverse and unleashing a gallery of alternate-reality villains that forces him to make the ultimate personal sacrifice.

source_details.synopsis: Spider-Man: No Way Home is a 2021 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man. Produced by Columbia Pictures, Marvel Studios, and Pascal Pictures, and distributed by Sony Pictures Releasing, it is the sequel to Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017) and Spider-Man: Far From Home (2019), and the 27th film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU). The film was directed by Jon Watts, written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers, and stars Tom Holland as Peter Parker / Spider-Man alongside Zendaya, Benedict Cumberbatch, Jacob Batalon, Jon Favreau, Jamie Foxx, Willem Dafoe, Alfred Molina, Benedict Wong, Tony Revolori, Marisa Tomei, Andrew Garfield, and Tobey Maguire.
